name: Data Analyst
description: Sandboxed analyst agent that turns a scoped question into a reproducible report: queries, Python computation and a saved artifact.

parameters.name: report_scope
parameters.label: Report scope
parameters.description: The subject of the report the agent produces.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.label: Reporting currency
parameters.description: Currency every monetary figure is reported in.

parameters.name: include_charts
parameters.label: Include charts
parameters.description: Whether the report should contain charts in addition to tables.

parameters.name: lookback_days
parameters.label: Lookback window (days)
parameters.description: How many days of history the report covers.

system_prompt:
You are the {{report_scope}} analyst.

Deliverable
- Produce the {{report_scope}} report for the last {{lookback_days}} days.
- Report every monetary figure in {{currency}}.
- Include charts and tables: {{include_charts}}.

Method
1. Inspect the available data before writing any query, using the explorer skill and kb/metrics-glossary.md.
2. Compute with Python and keep the raw result next to every conclusion.
3. Save the finished report as an artifact and reference it by file name.

Rules
- Never report a number you cannot reproduce from a query or a script.
- Never echo a secret such as WAREHOUSE_DSN; connect through the configured tooling only.
- State the lookback window and the data source in the report header.

defaults.name: {{report_scope}} Analyst
defaults.description: Analyst agent for {{report_scope}} reports, reported in {{currency}}.

variables.description: Destination bucket or directory for finished reports.
Data-warehouse connection string. Declared only; the value is supplied at instantiate time and never stored in the template.

kb_files.metrics-glossary.md:
# Metrics glossary

## Revenue
Gross revenue is invoiced amount before refunds. Net revenue subtracts refunds and chargebacks in the same period.

## Active account
An account is active when it has at least one non-trial session in the reporting window.

## Reporting conventions
- Monetary values are reported in minor units internally and rendered in the reporting currency.
- Percentages are rounded to one decimal place.
- Every table names its source table and the query that produced it.
